title: Star Trek actor Patrick Stewart dead at 86
summary: Patrick Stewart, British stage actor who found fame as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek, has died.

blocks.text: Patrick Stewart, British stage actor who found fame as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek, has died.
Death confirmed on stage actor's Instagram account
Patrick Stewart, British stage actor who found fame as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek, has died. He was 86 years old.
